terms.grammar: noun, second declension; usually plural, pāscua
evidence: Varr. RR 2.11.2: ab viridī pāscuō (Lewis & Short)

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 166.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
